notes.title: Server Maintenance
notes.content:
Buongiorno to everybody!

On the 23rd of April the multiplayer server will be down for maintenance.
The downtime will allow me to fix a small bug that has recently emerged, where players are unable to open new games due to the fact that "hidden" games are counted towards the limit of 10 games open per player.
By "hidden" games I mean all the ongoing games that a player is part of but that are not shown in the lobby for the following reasons:
[list]
[*] The game is over but not all the opponents have acknowledged the results yet
[*] The player resigned from a game but the game is still going
[/list]

Sadly, due to the fact that the server will actually be restarted, all the ongoing games will be lost.

Cheers,
Cody

notes.title: Patch 1.3.2 is live!
notes.content:
Buongiorno a tutti o'Magnifici!
Today we are releasing minor version (1.3.2) to the public branch!
In this patch we fixed a few bugs here and there and made minor improvements.

Some of the notable bug fixes are:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that during multiplayer games, among all the players online and in the game at the moment of the Game Over, only the player taking the last turn would see the Game Over animation
[*] Fixed "Unavailable Leader" error when activating Federico Da Montefeltro if he was cloned by Lorenzo de’ Medici
[/list]

Talking about minor improvements here are some worth mentioning:
[list]
[*] The religion track is now animated when players gain faith points
[*] During the Vatican Report phase, when a player support the Vatican, an animation shows the VP gain from that action
[*] Added a new icon for VPs given by Machiavelli.
[*] Changed the icons of Artisan, Peasant, Farmer and Scholar
[*] Added a small animation on tower entry values when acquiring cards like Leader and Stonemason that lower them
[/list]

As always thanks to all the people that submitted bug reports that helped us squashing these nasty bugs.

For a complete list of all the major bugs and changes always refer to the [url=https://trello.com/b/3G1vEBWk/lorenzo-il-magnifico-digital-roadmap]Trello Board[/url].

Thank you for your continued support and feedback.

Have a nice day!

Cody

notes.title: Version 1.3 brings Async multiplayer and UNDO feature
notes.content:
Howdy!
With today's patch, we are finally bringing a major update to our beloved Florentine game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/6cd17ab865a37c9cd5323124caa3defd16eeb5e5.png[/img]

[h1]Async multiplayer hits beta[/h1]
That's right, with the extensive tests we were able to do (thanks to those who played on the experimental branch, your help has been invaluable <3), we can finally move the asynchronous multiplayer system to the next level. This means:
[list]
[*] The Async lobby will replace the current multiplayer system entirely, even on the stable branch of the game.
[*] Multiplayer can *still* be played synchronously if all players are online and in-game at the same time.
[*] Steam Notifications will let players know when it's their turn, or when the game ends.
[/list]

For those who don't remember, this new system basically allows players to close Lorenzo even mid-game, and to play their turns when their opponents are offline. Those games save their state and can be later resumed.

Needless to say, the server is up again. Now go get some VPs.

[h1]Undo button undoes...stuff[/h1]
That's right. It took us a while, but finally it's possible to UNDO actions during single player games. A new button will appear next to the confirmation button every time you make an action - be it an actual Family member action, the choice of a bonus, the turn end, anything.
We hope you will appreciate it and put it to good use.

Older games *should* be compatible with this new update, but we encourage to start anew just to be sure.

[h1]Bugs, reports, and AIs[/h1]
Obviously it wouldn't be a significant update without some squish squash of other bugs around the game. Most notably, we finally figured out what was causing the AIs to get stuck from time to time; we hope this is the last time we need to address this issue. (If you still find a situation where the AI still soft locks the game, though, make sure to send a bug report through the game menu!)
For a complete list of all the bugs fixed, as usual, please refer to [url=https://trello.com/b/3G1vEBWk/lorenzo-il-magnifico-digital-roadmap]Lorenzo's roadmap[/url].

[h2]If you have issues while launching the game:[/h2]
Some testers (especially on OSX platforms) have reported that after the update, Steam throws an error whenever the game is launched:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/f5606459101fe37e5e3dbdf606063e75395fa387.png[/img]
[b]If this happens to you, simply uninstall and then reinstall the game. That should do the trick.[/b]
This is related to the game engine upgrade being unfriendly with Steam configuration files.



As usual, we'd like to thank our beloved players for keep on playing Lorenzo il Magnifico. You put fuel in our bones. And we appreciate your patience and support.

That's right. It took us a while, but finally it's possible to UNDO actions during single player games.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 brings Async Multiplayer on Experimental Branch
notes.content:
Howdy folks,

lately we've been busy with a little something a lot of you were hoping for: [b]asynchronous multiplayer[/b]!
As this feature is currently in its alpha stage, it is currently available only through the [b]Experimental Branch[/b]; read the following information to see how it works and how to get access to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/1ef27291f0945a9b1a27e5f0557d210fac677fc1.jpg[/img]

[h2]What are we talking about?[/h2]
This is a different approach to multiplayer. Unlike the current version where you have to stay online throughout the whole game (the "synchronous" multiplayer), in this new version you can exit the game whenever you see fit without losing any progress, just as it happens with offline games.

Another advantage of this new approach is when you create a match, if there is no one online in that moment, your "open game" will persist on the server and other players will be able to join later on. Once the adequate number of players is reached, the game will actually start.

[h2]Why is this an Alpha?[/h2]
We are still finalizing the core features and working out the last few bugs. Before we move on, we need to put the infrastructure through some good ol' stress test. Expect some minor inconveniences, and some occasional maintenance time.

As soon as the new system is solid enough, we will move everything to the main game branch.

[i]PLEASE NOTE: we will need to take down the server from time to time. When this happens, to ensure consistency, all online games will be deleted.[/i]

[h2]Is the system complete, feature-wise?[/h2]
Not yet. The Async multiplayer is still missing some major features, such as timers and notifications. We'll keep you posted as soon as something new is available.

[h2]What if something goes wrong?[/h2]
You may encounter issues while playing with this new system. If that happens, or if you see something out of place, don't forget to send a Bug report (or a general feedback) through the gameplay menu. Every report helps!
Of course, we already have a list of minor bugs we are working on. We'll get there, one step at a time.

[h2]How to switch to "Experimental" branch[/h2]
From your Steam library, right-click onto Lorenzo il Magnifico and choose "Properties...".
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/1b724c905fb857dbf75035e91ed773e4c497ad63.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/029e8eeb03f905e79f6fd8aeda49053ba590db91.png[/img][/url]
You'll be prompted with a popup. Click on "Beta" tab, where you'll find a dropdown menu. From it, just choose "experimental".
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/38e9d244ecfec997685f96405c0c0f61f50e9b54.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/226f271da94226992109e9848320e7c895a6c353.png[/img][/url]
The game should auto-update as usual, but if it doesn't, simply try restarting Steam.

If the procedure goes well, you should see [b]v.1.2.0[/b] on the top right corner of the main menu, once you open the game.

[i](If you ever want to get back to the current version, you can opt out with the same procedure by choosing "None" from the dropdown menu)[/i]

[h3]As usual, thank you for your invaluable support.[/h3]
If you need further assistance or wanna give us some feedback, don't forget to visit our Steam Community Page or peek around on BoardGameGeek!

notes.title: Patch 1.1, AI Fixes, More UI improvements
notes.content:
Good news everybody,

Lorenzo hits version 1.1 today, so let's review what's in it:
[list]
[*] Fixed some major cases where the [b]Experimental AI crashed[/b] and/or froze while thinking.
[*] Added [b]a new kind of AI[/b], called "Experimental #2", for you people to try out (more on this later).
[*] The [b]Religion track[/b] was moved from the church to the UI, where it's more readable. Also, the Cathedral dome is now bigger and allows the excommunication icons to be seen more clearly.
[*] Updated the priority of messages that appear under the log, so it should be clearer why some actions are unavailable according to the game state.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused buildings highlights to disappear after the first game.
[*] Minor fixes on glitches, animations timings, typos, etc.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/460e4b1966318a1f4e8d7f09ebbad8d42c379a22.png[/img]
[h2]What's with the new AI?[/h2]
The "Experimental #2" AI is yet another approach to solve the many issues the current AI has. While we are still collecting data about #1, thus figuring out how to enhance its decision-making (especially when it comes to Leaders), we decided to release this other synthetic brain to see what you people think.
Experimental #2 has a high disregard for Religion and Vatican but a higher chance to take advantage of combos, thus making it a diabolical (or at least heretical) personality overall.
And yep, you can guess it from the name, it's still experimental, so expect some bumps along the way. Speaking of which, don't miss the chance to send User Reports if you see it play dumb or make weird actions instead of obvious, more favorable options.

[h2]About the city design[/h2]
As many of you probably will notice, we took the chance to slightly change proportions to make information more readable. Towers now occupy a bigger portion of the screen and the other buildings have been moved as much as possible to accommodate a bigger space.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/f389a565741d34f532b692b4e4fca808aa69a945.png[/img]
We are really doing our best to satisfy as much feedback as possible, so thank you for your patience. Here's to hoping we'll be able to fiddle around even more in the future.

That's it for now. Let us know what you think!
And as always, take care.

[i](PSST! Shoutout to our top player Reggie for having spotted a last-minute bug before publication! The gameplay scene in your resolution should be back to normal.ːsteamhappyː)[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 out on Stable branch, Multiplayer fixes
notes.content:
Hey folks,

as the migration on the new Unity version went smooth and with no significant issues, we are finally ready to release the update on the stable branch, thus making it available for everyone.

Moreover, the issue when starting [b]4-players multiplayer[/b] matches should be fixed now. If you are still experiencing problems, however, reach out and we'll help as best as we can!

[h2]What about the AI?[/h2]
The hard "Experimental" AI will be available for everyone, too. But meanwhile, we keep fiddling with it, so expect some other upgrade in the future.

[h2]I was on Experimental branch, what do I do?[/h2]
If you opted-in on the experimental branch, you may want to go back to the Stable version to enjoy all new updates. Just do the same passages you did previously:
From your Steam Library, right-click onto Lorenzo il Magnifico, then choose "Properties...":
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/1b724c905fb857dbf75035e91ed773e4c497ad63.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/029e8eeb03f905e79f6fd8aeda49053ba590db91.png[/img][/url]
Then from the dropdown in the "Betas" tab, pick "None":
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/38e9d244ecfec997685f96405c0c0f61f50e9b54.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/226f271da94226992109e9848320e7c895a6c353.png[/img][/url]
The game should then update automatically (if not, you can force it by restarting Steam). Once it's done, the label "[experimental]" should disappear from the game name in the leftmost list of your games.

As always, thank you for your patience and your support. Lorenzo wouldn't be the same without your precious feedback. <3

Stay safe out there!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 and new AI system on Experimental branch
notes.content:
Fellow florentines,

Dario here - back with some updates on the current state of the art, roadmap, and future upgrades of our beloved Lorenzo.

As always, if you want to skip the boring chitchat, remember you can check our [url=https://trello.com/b/3G1vEBWk/lorenzo-il-magnifico-digital-roadmap]Roadmap on Trello[/url] to see some fancy images and a better sum up of the situation ːlunar2019piginablanketː

Don't forget to tell us what you think! (And if you see any particular weird action, or dumb move, don't forget to snap a screenshot and/or send a User report ːsteamthumbsupː)

[h3]How to switch to "Experimental" branch[/h3]
From your Steam library, right-click onto Lorenzo il Magnifico and choose "Properties...".
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/1b724c905fb857dbf75035e91ed773e4c497ad63.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/029e8eeb03f905e79f6fd8aeda49053ba590db91.png[/img][/url]
You'll be prompted with a popup. Click on "Beta" tab, where you'll find a dropdown menu. From it, just choose "experimental".
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/38e9d244ecfec997685f96405c0c0f61f50e9b54.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/226f271da94226992109e9848320e7c895a6c353.png[/img][/url]
The game should auto-update as usual, but if it doesn't, simply try restarting Steam.

If the procedure goes well, you should see v.1.0.1 b.2463 on the top right corner of the main menu, once you open the game.

[i](If you ever want to get back to the current version, you can opt out with the same procedure by choosing "None" from the dropdown menu)[/i]

[h3]Online 4-players games issues[/h3]
As some of you pointed out, there are issues when creating a 4-player online game. We are still working on this one. Please be patient, we'll hit you up as soon as we patch it.

[h2]What about the next stable version?[/h2]
Once we are done polishing the AI strategies through more playtesting, we should be able to release a new version anytime soon, hopefully as soon as the holiday season is over.

And while you wait, here is a little something as a preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/6b96f269a535ad2e16f7746fc5a069ea19b4c62a.png[/img]
What do you think of the new UI sizes and volumes? Can you spot all the changes?
Let us know if you like it in the comments!

notes.title: Lorenzo is going 1.0!
notes.content:
Howdy, people of Florence!

With today, we reach a long-awaited milestone on Lorenzo's journey: the game finally goes out of Early Access. Let's dive into the news!

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/a16d65201a4d32fd41542f570df309dfaf84d90e.png[/img] What's new[/h2]
Polish, polish, polish! We spent a considerable amount of time catching up with some evaded - yet important - tasks, such as making the colors more readable or fixing up some texts that were misbehaving.
The game should now be as stable as possible (with the exception of few graphical glitches that we'll fix soonish) and compatible to all screen resolutions. We hope you'll enjoy playing as much as we do!

For a complete list of changes see the end of the post - let's discuss more interesting things first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/6cd17ab865a37c9cd5323124caa3defd16eeb5e5.png[/img]

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/a16d65201a4d32fd41542f570df309dfaf84d90e.png[/img] To Err is human - but the AI knows better[/h2]
Version 1.0 allowed us to make some minor improvements to the medium AI; our goal was to make it a decent battleground to prepare players to the awesome world of multiplayer matches.

However, as you may recall from our latest blog post, we are still working on a Hard AI to challenge the most skilled players in offline mode. With this latest version comes a new tracking system which will give us a ton of information on how top tier players play - all the data will help our new AI to figure out the best way to build up a more efficient economy engine. So expect an update in the future - the moment our newborn baby is fed enough gameplay data, we will release the coveted new difficulty level.

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/a16d65201a4d32fd41542f570df309dfaf84d90e.png[/img] Post-launch roadmap[/h2]
We are still using [url=https://trello.com/b/3G1vEBWk/lorenzo-il-magnifico-digital-roadmap]Trello[/url] to keep track of what we are working on, so you can see there's still plenty of room for improvement.
Building a hard AI is still our top priority, and what will go into our next big release.
We do hope this release will bring in plenty of new feedback on how the game works, so that we can tinker with a new roadmap to share with you in the future according to how Lorenzo is perceived by our growing community.

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/a16d65201a4d32fd41542f570df309dfaf84d90e.png[/img] Special thanks[/h2]
Guys, gals, you know half of the success of this project belongs to you, our precious supporters - from the original backers to everyone who spent their time giving us their impression and point of view. We know you've been very patient and trustful. We do hope you will share today's moment of happiness with us, amidst this weird year that impacted all of us, one way or another.

Thank you for being part of this project! We hope you'll keep following us in the next steps of development, and share the joy of this little big German goliath with your friends. :3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/6cd17ab865a37c9cd5323124caa3defd16eeb5e5.png[/img]

[h3]Version 1.0 Changes and Fixes[/h3]
Here's the full list of improvements from the latest update:
[list]
[*] Added new tracking system for Players actions. This is a report tool to track anonymous data on how assets are chosen throughout the game, to analyze players strategies in order to improve the AI
[*] Implemented a new rule-based AI system on top of the current one, to allow future updates and data collection
[*] Improved AI - Medium basic ruleset (slight upgrade in score median)
[*] Full support for wide and ultra-wide aspect ratios; fixed many bugs related to popup visualization on 16:10+
[*] Improved color coding on Actions Log
[*] Fixed a soft-lock during Leaders Tutorial
[*] Polished some graphics during the gameover sequence and in some leader-related popups
[*] Some texts were reviewed and better localized
[*] Minor refactors, bugfixes, and code optimization
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2372 is here
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we are finally here with a new bunch of fixes for our beloved Magnifico.
Mostly and most important, we finished the bulk of the rework that was necessary to allow aspect ratios over 16:9 to work properly. This means, all of you who own an ultra-wide screen will be able to finally enjoy the gameplay in all its fullscreen grace.

After some initial tests, we opted to leave the majority of interaction within the central part of the screen, to avoid obnoxiously long movements to reach every action slot inside the city. This is how Florence should look on a 3440x1440 resolution:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/0dff35d6a667e00553df1b98d26d0e14cc87d2aa.png[/img]


Meanwhile, we obviously took the chance for some other bug fixing:
[list]
[*] Tower slots still unoccupied, can now be interacted with even during opponents turn. This helps newcomers during multiplayer matches, who can now inspect available actions with their dedicated descriptions.
[*] Characters and Quests previously purchased can now be clicked to properly open a detailed view in player's own board.
[*] Military points abacus should now work properly, with no color mismatching nor ghostly soldiers.
[*] Multiplayer invitations conveyed through the Steam overlay should now be properly received even if players are already inside the online section of the game.
[*] Added an AI to substitute players in the event of a mid-game disconnection.
[*] Minor fixes on texts, typos, and plain dumb wrong translations (duh).
[/list]

There are some minor graphical issues we still have to fix, but that shouldn't take too much, so probably some minor hotfixes will follow in the next few days. If you see something that makes you turn up your nose, feel free to report it through the usual comm channels.

[h3]Before we forget...[/h3]
Looks like some of you spotted the return of a [b]FirstLevelValidationFail[/b] error, which can now happen during multiplayer matches. It seems sometimes, Leaders ready to be befriended may send their envelope during other players' turns - we'll be on it asap, but meanwhile, remember to NOT interact with those envelopes outside of your turn.

[h3]For anything else...[/h3]
...be sure to check the updated [url=https://trello.com/b/3G1vEBWk/lorenzo-il-magnifico-digital-roadmap]roadmap on Trello[/url] or leave a message on [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/thread/2227649/lorenzo-il-magnifico-digital-edition-steam-feedbac]BoardGameGeek[/url] :)

Take care!

notes.title: Lorenzo Digital Roadmap: The update you were waiting for!
notes.content:
Greetings, people!

Today we'd like to share a little more insight of what's lying ahead on the (hopefully) last steps of this Early Access path. Our starting plan was to publish 10 major updates, from 0.1 being the first playable alpha to 1.0 being the update leaving Early Access, while obviously collecting some data (through gameplay sessions and user reports) to integrate as much feedback as possible from the community.

So before we move to what's left on the schedule, we felt like it was nice to share some little peek at the numbers, to figure out what we've been doing lately:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/3034457a308de81d13f1b2c5a54f0df0f161a3bd.png[/img]
As far as 2020 goes, we've been working on a total of 209 tasks, usually ranging from few hours to a couple of days long, which represent small bits of work we usually follow during our daily routine. Sometimes, one ticket on Trello equals to one task; most of the time, it's actually split into smaller tasks, which are closer to the game architecture (thus helping programmers figuring out how to do it).

But hey! I bet you are here to learn what was that secret stuff we were working on, right? Ah well, nobody cares about spreadsheets anyway, so...

[h2]> Version 0.9 will bring multiplayer in Florence[/h2]
And finally! Playing online was one of the main features unlocked during the Kickstarter campaign, and we couldn't wait to put our dirty hands into it. :) As you can imagine, the game structure needed some slight fixing around to allow multiplayer to work (and some major testing overall), which is where most of our time went lately. We decided it was worth putting everything aside for a moment to provide this feature, as it was among the main requests both we and Cranio Creations receive everyday :3
We are planning to release the new multiplayer feature (which uses Steam, so no further authentication or subscription is required on your side) in the next few days, starting [b]tomorrow[/b].

[h2]> Version 1.0 will make everything stable and improve the AI[/h2]
For those who like playing Lorenzo like Han from a galaxy far, far away, there is still work to do on the general AI performance in terms of sheer score, Leader management and general decisions.
Now, those who have followed the development for a while may have noticed there has been a general, albeit small, improvement in the average score the hard AI gets every time. Our plan is to fiddle more with its behaviours to hopefully raise that average (well, median actually) around 80 or more, or at least to make it feel more competitive towards the same assets players usually prefer. The only issue with that, is we need more and more game data! So every completed match, either ours or yours, matters to this common goal.
Now, as we work towards this, there will be time to deal with all other bugs and reports which were temporarily set aside, which we will discuss soon.

[h2]> And then? What's next?[/h2]
After we hit the final release, surely there will still be some minor issues to fix around, so no worries: we won't disappear. We will update our Trello board to track all new requests and then figure out what goes where. And of course, we will leave our user report system inside the game, so you'll be able to reach out whenever you need.

[h3]Speaking of Trello...[/h3]
While we were prepping up the multiplayer stuff, I took the chance to clean up our [url=https://trello.com/b/3G1vEBWk/lorenzo-il-magnifico-digital-roadmap]Trello board[/url], to move the tickets to the next release, archive the outdated ones, and generally tidy up the place.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34814912/0829244bef9715a2426cccacb11265f7c302bc2d.png[/img]

Here's a little more detail on each category on the left of the next release:
[list]
[*] [b]Working on[/b] - That's what we are focusing on at the moment, if it's not yet ready for the next release.
[*] [b]Bugs[/b] - Plain and simple, stuff that doesn't work. This usually has top priority as it may lead to unwanted crashes, soft locks, and whatnot. This list should be empty when 1.0 kicks in.
[*] [b]ToDo[/b] - Generally speaking, this is what we feel like it's necessary to bring Lorenzo to the quality standard we had invisioned when we started. Most of this will be dealt with when 1.0 is released, but something else may slip after the major update.
[*] [b]UserReport Issues[/b] - this is basically what was reported by you guys (at least, the most of it) which we haven't dealt with yet, either because it's too time consuming or because it wasn't reported by a consistent amount of people. We will have to consider the amount of resources we will have after the 1.0 release, then plan accordingly. Currently there is no estimated time for these, but things may change in the future.
[/list]
As always, feel free to reach out here, on our [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/thread/2227649/lorenzo-il-magnifico-digital-edition-steam-feedbac]BoardGameGeek dedicated thread[/url], or through other official channels.

Before we depart, one final thought: remember Studio Clangore is a small indie studio, and as such, we literaly depend on people's opinion and kindness. Because of this, we want to thank every single one of you who contributed (and still does!) by sending reports, sharing opinions, writing on BGG, or simply talking about the game with friends. This really means a lot, both to us and to the almighty Cranio Creations. <3

See you soon!

notes.title: Patch 2199 and Project Updates
notes.content:
Hey folks,

It's been a while! So long, actually, that I feel like I need to personally apologize for disappearing from the radars until today. The end of 2019 has been quite the challenging period on a personal level, and then, as soon as the new year went into full rampage, the COVID-19 emergency started. As some of you probably know, our studio is in the northern part of Italy, where the situation has been quite critical. Though we are now equipped to work remotely, we had some issue in pursuing our everyday work schedule these last few weeks, thus delaying even more our planned update.

Since some of you have raised concern over the current state of the project, let me reassure you: [b]we have not abandoned Lorenzo il Magnifico.[/b] We will keep on working over it and be here for our community as much as possible.

Then, as soon as the emergency is over and we can go back to our usual development schedule, we will reschedule and share a better planning for the release of the missing content, provided 2020 stops trying to kill us.

But enough gobbledygook, here's what we have been working on so far:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bunch of situations where the AI got stuck while thinking - most of which were reported by you. Many thanks!
[*] Improved some evaluations related to the AI. There's still some work to do here; currently the "Medium" one settles its score around 65-70 points, which is still not enough. This is still where most of our effort is put at the moment.
[*] It is now possible to resume a saved game; games are saved automatically when the game is closed.
[*] Fixed a bug on Cards with on the fly effects (such as the Architect) related to some Excommunication effects.
[*] Fixed a glitch where Excommunications taken by opponents were shown on the player's board instead.
[/list]

Stay safe and take care,
D. from Studio Clangore and Cranio Digital

notes.title: Version 0.8 is a Majestic update!
notes.content:
Dear Lorenzo's friends, update 0.8 is here! It took us slightly more than we were originally planned, but we are glad to share a bunch of improvements with our favorite community:
[list]
[*] Free navigation system: it is now possible to switch from every action slot to another without the need to press the X at the top.
[*] Excommunications: there's now a clearer, more epic feedback for excommunications and their effects.
[*] Action details reworked: an improved description when a card is selected better shows details of prices, effects etc.
[*] Opponents Faith: since many of you requeste it, a small banner on the side of the Cathedral now shows easily where opponents are on their Faith track.
[*] Icons review: many icons have been reworked to better recall the basic game iconography.
[*] Price banners and colors review: we increased saturation to improve banners readability.[/list]
Version 0.8 was also a good occasion to introduce a couple of fixes around:
[list][*] Leonardo Da Vinci no longer causes the game to get stuck upon usage.
[*] Some weird behaviours related to Family Members placements on Harvest/Production buildings are now fixed.
[*] Thanks to your user reports, we found many situations where the AI got stuck and caused errors. It still needs improvements in terms of general strategy, but it should cause less-to-none errors right now.
[*] Removed the gold coin from the Council palace animation when the Privilege is taken through some other mean.
[*] The bug tracking system has been improved under the hood to track more data, hopefully to help other unexpected behaviours in the future.[/list]
Want to share your feedback with us? Remember, you're always welcome to join the discussion on our [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/thread/2227649/lorenzo-il-magnifico-digital-edition-steam-feedbac]BoardGameGeek forum[/url].

Ciao!

notes.title: Patch 0.7.1848 / 1849 is here!
notes.content:
With this version get ready for a bunch of news, including:
[list]
[*] A Bug reporting System has been added to help us during the development process. You can either manually report a bug from the pause menu, or let the system handle it whenever something goes wrong.
[*] We implemented a localization system to be ready for translating to new languages! For testing purposes, aside of English, Italian is now available. Languages can be switched through Options inside the main menu.
[*] We kept working on the user interface to make all papers, letters and assets detail more readable and organized. There's still a lot to do, but we hope you will appreciate the small steps :)
[*] Cards granting bonus actiong (such as the Abbess) has been reworked once again, to hopefully crush every remaining bug during their usage.
[*] Many other small improvements both on the AI and on the general game system (which, as always, you can read on our [url=https://trello.com/b/3G1vEBWk/lorenzo-il-magnifico-digital-roadmap]Trello page[/url].
[/list]

Let us know what you think! And [i]buon gioco[/i]!
